rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Taxpayer Name on Item 7.
rules.official_behavior: The printed field is Item 6, but Save reports Item 7.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use Item 6 consistently.

rules.condition: Only one or two return-date components are populated.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The Save condition uses AND, so any partially populated date bypasses the date check.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require all three components together and validate the composed date.

rules.condition: Year contains nonnumeric text introduced without keypress filtering.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Blank, range, and date comparisons do not reject NaN text; paste/programmatic input can pass.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Parse a four-digit integer and reject nonnumeric input.

rules.condition: Payment date is future or before 2018.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The field is cleared, but isValid remains true for future and pre-2018 branches.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Return false for every rejected date.

rules.condition: Others row rate, export, taxable, or due changes.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: computeOthers reads values but never computes Due; dynamically added Due is editable and included in totals.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Compute due from the legally applicable rate and taxable base; keep output read-only.

rules.condition: Any Others row is incomplete or no Schedule 1 taxable row exists.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Main Validate never calls isValidDataOnSched1 and does not require any tax row.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Validate Schedule 1 completeness and the legal zero-return case explicitly.

rules.condition: Edit is clicked while Tax Relief Yes remains selected.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The Yes branch always disables Item 12A even when param is false, so Edit does not restore the specification field.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Enable Item 12A in edit mode when Yes is selected.

rules.condition: Any Validate-only required field is missing.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Save checks only return date, TIN, RDO, and name.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use a shared phase-aware validation graph.

rules.condition: Email is malformed or blank.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The current form serializes email but validateForm never checks it.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Apply the shared email rule if the official/legal workflow requires email.
